messages:
alex: Heads-up — after yesterday's autotune rollout I'm seeing a p50 regression (~12%) for short sequences (<=32) on the small-gpu pool. Affects gpt-small-q4 and a few compatible variants. :thinking:

maria: Confirmed. Traces show the kernel selector has started preferring matmul_fused_v2 for short seqs. That kernel has lower per-token time but a higher launch cost and worse KV-warmup behavior. Continuous batching is packing many tiny requests so the launch overhead becomes dominant.

liam: perf-bot flagged it too: 'perf-bot: regression detected: 12.3% p50 increase on small-gpu pool for model gpt-small-q4 after autotune deployment at 1754400000' :warning:

liam: Quick pprof excerpt from a 60s capture (aggregated across requests):
```
# CPU (GPU wall) breakdown
matmul_fused_v2_launch        2.1s
matmul_fused_v2_kernel_exec   1.6s
matmul_unfused_launch         0.3s
matmul_unfused_kernel_exec    2.4s
kv_cache_populate             0.9s
overhead_scheduler            0.8s
```
packets: 1200 requests; avg seq=18; avg batch assembled=6
```

jen: TL;DR: fused wins when amortized over long sequences or big batches. With continuous batching we often don't amortize the launch. Also KV-cache refill penalty hits fused path worse (cache unfriendly layout).

alex: Any quick mitigations? Canary rollback?

maria: Short-term: revert autotune for that model on small-gpu pool or add a safelist that forces matmul_unfused for seq<=32. Long-term: update cost model to include launch_time + kv_warm_penalty and schedule-awareness.

jen: Proposal for autotuner patch (sketch):
```
score(kernel, meta) = per_token_time * expected_tokens(batch, seq) + launch_time * expected_launches + kv_penalty * p_kv_miss
where expected_launches = 1 if batch_latency_budget > launch_time_threshold else 1 + ceil(batch_fragments)
```
Add features: device_arch, avg_seq, contbatch_fragmentation, kv_hit_rate. Feed into the tuner regression test harness.

liam: I can add a microbenchmark that simulates continuous batching shapes (poisson arrivals, payload dist) and measure effective latency+cost for both kernels. We should also add a short-seq canary that pins matmul_unfused and compare p50/p95.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Created rollback PR #6721 (revert autotune for gpt-small-q4 on small-gpu) — awaiting review.

alex: Sounds good. Action items: liam -> microbench + pprof traces; jen -> implement cost-model change in tuner; maria -> toggle canary/rollback if numbers still bad. I'll coordinate with infra for canary traffic.

maria: One more note: KV cache warmup traces show a hot path where matmul_fused_v2 triggers a memory copy pattern that increases GPU L2 thrash. I'll attach a minimal repro later. For now, add a kv_penalty default = 0.6ms per cache refill in tuner to prevent aggressive fused picks.

liam: I'll also instrument the scheduler to emit a small metric: batch_fragments per route (helps autotuner estimate expected_launches).

alex: Thanks — please post short findings in this thread. If rollback PR merges we'll watch metrics over next 2 deploy windows. :thumbsup:
